claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_spell_modifier family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature permanently waives the material component for Summon Dragon. There is no class feature family for always-on passive modifications to how a specific named spell is cast. ClassFeatureMechanics only has the 'activation' family, which requires a cost + resource + effect; a passive modifier has no activation event.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can cast Summon Dragon without a Material component.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect::grant_free_cast
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants one slot-less casting of a named spell per long rest. ClassFeatureEffect is currently GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect — there is no variant for granting free access to a specific spell with a use_count resource and long_rest reset cadence. v4 taxonomy has grant_spell_access as an atom, but it is not wired into ClassFeatureEffect in the surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_cast_properties (or metamagic_substitute)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: At the moment of casting, the sorcerer may voluntarily trade away the Concentration requirement in exchange for reducing the spell's duration to 1 minute. This is a player-choice, cast-time property substitution with no v4 atom. suppress acts on an already-active effect; replace acts on a prior instance; there is no atom for 'at cast time, optionally swap one duration/concentration shape for another'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require Concentration. If you do so, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.
